entries.0a15d58f58b2008d: This business sells LPG (liquefied petroleum gas), LNG (liquefied natural gas) and heat. It also sells LPG appliances, performs LPG piping work, and sells coke and petroleum products. LPG sales are handled by Toho Liquefied Gas Co., Ltd. and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥95,336 million, down 4.8% year on year, due to factors including lower LPG unit prices. The number of LPG customers was 646,000, and sales volume was 473,000 tonnes (down 0.2% year on year).
entries.571baff8dada1bfa: A company that delivers energy such as city gas, electricity and LPG, mainly in Aichi, Mie and Gifu.
entries.96d2be9649c4f949: This is a category of business segments not included in reportable segments. It includes LNG contract processing, real estate management and leasing, plant and facility design and construction, the CN×P business, sales of residential equipment, information processing, leasing, and development and investment related to natural gas and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥35,389 million. Overseas development and investment in natural gas and others is handled by Group companies such as Toho Gas Ichthys Pty Ltd in Australia and Group companies in Canada.
